User Ask Examples: “Create a charter from this BRD” / “Generate charter” / “Draft project charter”
Mapped State(s): Input Received → Select Action → Select Format → Generating → Complete
Happy Path Flow: User uploads BRD → Agent: “Got it. What would you like me to create?” → User: “Charter” → Agent: “Okay, what formats?” → User: “Word and PDF” → Agent: “✓ Charter.docx ✓ Charter.pdf ready.”
Negative Path Flow: User: “Generate charter” (no file uploaded) → Agent: “Please upload or paste your requirements first.” OR User: “Generate charter in Excel” → Agent: “Excel isn’t supported for charters. Would you like Word or PDF instead?”
